name: moveTo
doc: when user asks an agent to move to a specific spot or environment object in the world, use this action. spotName is the name of the spot or environment object. The 'agent' field on the action object identifies which NPC performs it.

name: moveToPoint
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: when the user asks an agent to go to an arbitrary point in the world, use this action. x, y, z are the coordinates of the point. The 'agent' field on the action object identifies which NPC performs it.

name: talk
doc: use this action when the user asks something or where a comment to some other action is appropriate. msg is the text to say. The 'agent' field on the action object identifies which NPC is speaking.

name: grab
doc: the agent named in the action's 'agent' field picks up a named object from the environment. DO NOT grab if that agent's itemInRightHand is already non-empty. DO NOT grab if the object has grabbable: false, regardless of what the name suggests. Always do moveTo for this agent to get close to the object first. Each agent can hold only ONE item at a time, but different agents can each hold their own item simultaneously.

name: place
doc: the agent named in the action's 'agent' field places the item currently in its own itemInRightHand onto the named environment object. Precondition: that agent's itemInRightHand must be non-empty. If it is empty, there is nothing for that agent to place, use talk instead. Always do moveTo for this agent to get close to the target object first.

name: give
doc: the agent named in the action's 'agent' field gives the item currently in its own itemInRightHand to the agentToGive in parameters. Precondition: that agent's itemInRightHand must be non-empty. If it is empty, there is nothing for that agent to place, use talk instead. Always do moveTo for this agent to get close to agentToGive first.
